new_value: German North Sea LNG, Jade Energy
source_notes: TES (Tree Energy Solutions) launched a new dedicated brand/platform called 'Jade Energy' for its Wilhelmshaven Green Energy Hub / import terminal project on 2026-04-30 (tes-h2.com press release, quote from Jade Energy Managing Director Raf Vermeyen: 'This project has always been central to our strategy in Germany. Jade Energy reflects the scale of our ambition'). The live jadeenergy.de site confirms the Wilhelmshaven LNG/e-NG terminal project page and lists Fortescue as a partner ('About Fortescue' nav item). Trade press (energate-messenger.com/news/261650, headline 'Wilhelmshaven import terminal is now called Jade Energy') independently reported the same rebrand, but the article 403-blocked WebFetch and has no Wayback snapshot yet, so it could not be directly verified -- treated as corroborating context only, not a cited source. Both cited URLs are same corporate family (TES/Jade Energy), so this is effectively ONE independent source per the mirror-URL rule; staged at yellow, not green. [citation repair 2026-07-17: replaced bare homepage jadeenergy.de with the specific verified page(s).]
